import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
for i in range(1,8):
    base = (i-1)*3
    ws.cell(row=i, column=4).value = '=INDEX(\$A\$1:\$A\$21,' + str(base+1) + ')'
    ws.cell(row=i, column=5).value = '=INDEX(\$A\$1:\$A\$21,' + str(base+2) + ')'
    ws.cell(row=i, column=6).value = '=INDEX(\$A\$1:\$A\$21,' + str(base+3) + ')'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
